dataset.citation: CDC Diabetes Health Indicators [Dataset]. (2017). UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C53919.
dataset.cohort_reuse: Exact fixed-seed stratified cdc45k cohort from tools/campaign/campaign_lib.R; verify its original logistic prepared CSV SHA256 before changing target to BMI. Diabetes_binary is used only to preserve the original sampling and split strata.
dataset.heldout_policy: Preparation only routes rows; no held-out BMI summaries, model fitting, predictions, metrics, or setting selection

split.stratification: Diabetes_binary; BMI is never used for cohort selection or splitting
split.method: Reuse the original campaign_split: R set.seed(seed), sample 20% within each diabetes stratum for test, then shuffle each training stratum and deal round-robin to three sites.
split.overlap: No source row shared between training/test or between sites

protocol.bounds_policy: Reuse the previously declared public clipping interval BMI [12,98]; client harness transforms training targets to (clip(BMI,12,98)-55)/43. Unchanged runner clips these targets to [-1,1], scales features through the original public bounds to [-1,1], and returns public-unit predictions. Harness inverts predictions with 55+43*prediction. No empirical centering, scaling or prediction clipping.

privacy.randomness: Unchanged node secrets and canonical sticky seeding; replicate split seeds are not DP noise seeds; no composition claim across trainings

protocol.central: OLS with intercept on all 36000 original training rows using the same public feature transform and float32 public-unit targets; predictions mapped back to BMI units.
protocol.trivial: Mean of the original BMI values of all training rows

metrics.prediction_postprocessing: 55+43*prediction; no clipping; raw held-out BMI truth

criteria: federated-DP RMSE below training-mean predictor RMSE
diagnostics.interpretation: Annotations only, never pass/fail gates or reasons to rerun

protocol.selection: One declared third cell, three epsilons and three seeds, each trained/scored once. Reuse existing cohort and split files. No held-out file opened before final scoring callback. No tuning, fallback, retries of scored cells or further alternative.
protocol.schedule_rationale: Keep defaults: 375 steps per round and 1875 over five rounds. Unit-clipped signal has nominal cumulative intercept-motion bound 18.75, far above public target magnitude <=1; raw target mean approximately 28 exceeded that bound. Poisson sampling makes per-step signal bound .01*actual_batch_size/32; Gaussian noise is unbounded. Reachability does not prove convergence.
